Run a bundled example app

Source: R/examples.R
run_example.Rd

Launches one of the example apps shipped in the package's examples folder. Each is an app directory with an app.R that calls spigot_app(); read them with system.file("examples", package = "spigot").

Usage

run_example(name = "minimal", ...)

Arguments

name

Name of the example: "minimal", "live" or "site".

...

Passed to shiny::runApp(), for example port or launch.browser.

Value

The value of shiny::runApp(), once the app is stopped.

Details

  • "minimal": one hand-written HTML page that calls a plumber API mounted in the same Shiny app: a GET with a query parameter, a JSON POST, an endpoint that returns a data frame and validates its input, and a slow async endpoint that does not block other requests.

  • "live": a count shared by every open tab. Each click is an HTTP call; R pushes the new count to every tab with spigot_broadcast(), and sets an input of the calling tab with spigot_trigger() so its server function updates a Shiny output on the page.

  • "site": three pages built from whisker templates that share partials, one rendered from data in R, and an endpoint that does its work in a future worker. Needs the future package.

Examples

if (interactive()) {
  run_example("live")
}
# The bundled examples:
list.files(system.file("examples", package = "spigot"))
#> [1] "live"    "minimal" "site"
